admission_proposal.name: Shandong University Longshan — Phase 1 Data Centre and Research Platform

status.summary: The contractor reports the integrated Phase 1 building has finished its underground structure and is undergoing aboveground main-structure construction. Its northern zone contains compute machine rooms and support spaces; southern research and offices are separate functions. September 7 is the current contractor-report confirmation, not an invented exact milestone day.

admission_proposal.inclusion_review: The original national data-centre machine-room design tender establishes a physical data-centre facility; the current contractor describes north compute rooms and support spaces and a future regional data-centre function. This is not an admission based only on a generic university research building or software initiative.
admission_proposal.mixed_use_limit: The Phase 1 physical data-centre/compute-machine-room facility is the north functional portion of the integrated project. The mapped parent project also contains south research/office functions. No standalone data-hall boundary or size is established.

geometry.precision: Representative point inside the community-mapped property named for the Phase 1 mixed-use project. It does not identify the northern compute rooms, an individual building footprint, an entrance, an active-work boundary, the whole university campus or an official surveyed parcel.
geometry.identity_review: The original Jinan survey tender identifies the exact Shandong University Longshan Digital Support Research Platform Phase 1 project in Zhangqiu. The original national procurement notice explicitly identifies the data-centre machine-room design at that same campus and jointly names Shandong University and CSCEC Fifth Bureau as tenderers. The September contractor article uses a short project title but its rendering title names the exact Phase 1 EPC scope, and its body explicitly separates north compute rooms from south research offices. OSM way 1551159473 bears the exact official project title; the neighbouring Digital Innovation Centre is separately mapped as way 1551159472 and is excluded. The selected map feature is therefore a named project property, not an address geocode or an inferred whole-university marker. No claim is made that a primary planning map independently validates the OSM boundary.
geometry.uncertainty_reason: The community map gives no measured horizontal accuracy or verified displacement to the northern machine-room portion.

admission_proposal.date_review: September 7 is the current original contractor-report confirmation. The recent underground-completion milestone has no exact date. June 30, 2025 survey publication and February 5, 2026 design tender are historical identity/scope evidence, not current status.
admission_proposal.source_image_limit: The contractor image is explicitly a rendering. Only its full-project title is used for identity; the image filename date is not a construction observation.

primary_planning_search.outcome: An accessible public planning frontend was inspected. The ordinary exact-name post-approval search returned embedded documentList=[]; the documented public getDocumentList route failed with a redirect loop. No planning notice or parcel map was established.
primary_planning_search.limits: No issued permit or independently verified official boundary is claimed. The admitted locator rests on the exact named OSM project property and primary project identity, consistent with the accepted parent-property-marker scope. No blocked route bypass or repeat.
